idea: Epic 23 build tasks (Examples + Launch): 23.3 a Todo example (CRUD: create, list, toggle, delete; demonstrates server actions); 23.6 Docker image publish (the engine image on GitHub Container Registry); 23.7 single binary build (bun build --compile, downloadable for Linux, macOS, Windows); 23.8 GitHub release (tag, release notes, binary assets, changelog). Publishing stays with the user (release.sh tags; images and releases go out on a tag).
